# SLE Sierra Leone: nothing found (sites unreachable)

- Statistics Sierra Leone: http://www.statistics.sl/ returned a SiteGround bot-check page (meta refresh to /.well-known/sgcaptcha/), and https returned no connection. The statistical yearbook / crime-by-district tables could not be reached.
- Sierra Leone Police: police.gov.sl, slp.gov.sl and sl.police.gov.sl gave no connection.
- One web search was attempted ("Sierra Leone Police annual crime statistics murder by district report pdf Statistics Sierra Leone"), but the turn's search budget was already used up, so no results came back.
- No figures were seen. Suggested next routes: Stats SL "Annual Statistical Digest" (has a "Crime" chapter with offences by police division), via a browser that passes the captcha; SLP "Crime Statistics" annual PDFs; the Sierra Leone Police Annual Report.

## Retry (retry_within_a, 18 Oct 2026): FOUND
- https://www.statistics.sl/ is now reachable (no captcha). Its publications page (/index.php/resources/publications.html) hosts two usable files, both downloaded and read:
  1. Sierra Leone Police Annual Crime Statistics Report (file name says 2018; content covers 2017). Table 7 "Murder (Homicide) Cases" by region/division and month. Extracted all 7 rows x 12 months + totals.
  2. Annual Statistical Digest 2007-2013, Tables 4.3a-c (2007, 2008, 2009) and 4.3b (2011): "Murder" by region (West, South, East, North). The digest's crime tables for 2010, 2012 and 2013 were not found in the text layer.
- Inconsistencies in the source: the 2017 text says the Western Area "alone recorded 71", but its table gives Freetown East 37 + Freetown West 67 = 104. Rows follow the table. The 2017 Freetown West July cell is split in the PDF text as "1" over "1"; read as 11 because the row total (67) and the column total (17) both need 11.
- The 2011 continuation page has no header row; the column order (East, West, North, South) is taken from the page before it.
- 2007-2009 regions are four (West, South, East, North); 2017 uses six (North East, North West, Southern, Eastern, Freetown East, Freetown West). Not comparable without merging.
